math.description: Kusukela ezingeni lamabanga aphansi kuya phezulu, funda ukucabanga ngezibalo okusebenzayo nokuxazulula izinkinga zangempela ngezinselelo ezijabulisayo.

english.description: Ngale kokulungiselela izivivinyo—funda isiNgisi esisebenzayo sezingxoxo zansuku zonke, ukukhula emsebenzini, ebhizinisini nasohambweni lomhlaba ngezinselelo ezimfushane.

korean.description: Kusukela kuhlamvu lwe-Hangul kuya esiKorea sebhizinisi, vula amathuba nobudlelwano obusha ngezifundo ezichazwe ngolimi lwakho.

physics.description: Imisebenzi yokuhlola ifiziksi ewusizo ukuze uqonde imithetho yemishini, ugesi namandla.

chemistry.description: Imisebenzi yokuhlola ikhemistri ewusizo ukuze uqonde ukwakheka kwezinto, ukusabela namakhemikhali empilweni yansuku zonke.
